note: Requires an Arduino Uno Q properly programmed
Provides unoq_source, unoq_filter, and unoq_sink plugins to read and write data to the Arduino Uno Q MCU
Requires Ubuntu 22.04 or later to compile
Requires an Arduino Uno Q to run
You might need to remove the quarantine protection on the plugin once installed
macOS is supported for development only, and not for production use
